q: What is the minimum order quantity?
a: Our MOQ is 100 pieces per style for catalogue designs. For custom and private-label orders the minimum is 200 pieces per design.

q: What product categories do you offer?
a: We specialise in kurtis (cotton, rayon, printed, embroidered), gowns (floor-length, anarkali) and contemporary tops. Custom designs are also welcome.

q: Can I place a custom or private-label order?
a: Yes. Share your design brief and reference images on WhatsApp or by email. We quote within 24 hours and manufacture from 200 pieces with your branding, labels and packaging.
Wholesale prices start from ₹180 per piece for kurtis. Gowns and tops vary with fabric and design complexity. We send a full price list on request.
50% advance at order confirmation and 50% before dispatch, by NEFT, RTGS, IMPS or UPI. We share bank details once your order is confirmed.

q: How long does production and delivery take?
a: Standard catalogue orders take 7–15 days. Custom orders take 20–30 days depending on quantity and complexity. We ship across India with Delhivery, Bluedart and DTDC.

q: Are samples available before bulk ordering?
a: Yes. Samples are available at a nominal charge, which is adjusted against your first bulk order. WhatsApp us with the design you'd like to see.
Yes — custom woven labels, hang tags, polybag printing and branded cartons. The MOQ is 200 pieces per style.

q: What fabrics do you work with?
a: Cotton, rayon, georgette, crepe, linen and blends. We can also source fabric to your specification for larger orders.

q: How do I check quality before a large order?
a: Every dispatch is quality-checked twice at our end. For new buyers we recommend ordering a sample set first. Defective pieces are replaced in your next order.

q: Can I visit your factory in Jaipur?
a: Yes. Retailers, boutique owners and wholesalers are welcome to visit our Jaipur production unit. Book a slot on WhatsApp or through the visit form on the site.

q: How do I place my first order?
a: Fill in the enquiry form or send us a WhatsApp with your requirements. We reply within 2 business hours with pricing and next steps.
